## Purpose

Deploy-image operational scripts that remain outside the request path. The Cognito-only cutover
removes local bootstrap and break-glass administration; these scripts instead reconcile the local
projection against the provider and safely finish deferred provider deletions.

## Shape

- [reconcile_cognito_users.py](../../backend/app/scripts/reconcile_cognito_users.py) â€” reports local/pool drift and may repair only the
  narrow safe case: a local projection whose Cognito subject is confirmed missing or disabled is
  marked disabled locally. Provider uncertainty is reported rather than converted into a write.
- [retry_cognito_deletions.py](../../backend/app/scripts/retry_cognito_deletions.py) â€” drains durable `pending_cognito_deletions` records left when
  the final `AdminDeleteUser` call failed after the local user and dependents were removed. It
  reports first and applies explicit retry work without resurrecting local ownership data.
- [__init__.py](../../backend/app/scripts/__init__.py) â€” package marker.

## Why this shape

Provider reconciliation and final delete retry are deployment/operations concerns, not HTTP
handlers and not an identity authority of their own. Keeping them as explicit container commands
makes their side effects auditable while preserving the runtime invariant that Cognito is the sole
interactive credential authority and the local row is only a projection/ownership record.

Nothing in the application imports this module; deploy or scheduled operational tooling invokes
these commands deliberately. The retired `bootstrap_admin.py` and `recover_admin.py` paths must
not be reintroduced as local-auth fallbacks.
